propositions: Extract runner orchestration from provider workflows into a packaged Python core exposed through library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run), and MCP (bridge_run tool) with consistent behavior across all three surfaces.

Support five canonical profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to existing rebar subcommands while retaining legacy MODE environment variable compatibility in provider workflows.
Validate and deliver from all supported install paths (pip wheel, Homebrew wheel-backed environment, MCP Registry/uvx) without requiring repository-local scripts in CI.
Preserve direct legacy reconcile caller behavior (benign results 3/4/75) while translating them to canonical 0 for new provider-runner callers.
Validate provider schemas offline and lint embedded shell with pinned ShellCheck; ensure strict delivery on successful non-paused runs with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always.
